summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the Executive Tasks feature (checklists, to-dos, Today card, DAR prefill, site_label banner, admin overview, staff blocked). Backend pytest 7/7 passing. Frontend flows verified for exec, admin and staff. Found one UI bug: off-site status banner reads contradictory 'Currently on campus Off-site · X km from <site>' (both phrases concatenated).

ui_bugs.issue: When exec is checked in but out_of_geofence=true, the banner renders 'Currently on campus Off-site · 504.5 km from Rowing Academy'. The 'Currently on campus' prefix is unconditionally emitted and then siteLine adds 'Off-site · ...' - grammatically contradictory. Expected either 'Off-site · X m from <site>' alone, or a distinct 'Off-site' banner.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> option cannot be a child of <span>' emitted from Layout.jsx line 376 when rendering tasks_today badge (option element misused inside span). Non-blocking, but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Fix banner wording in SelfCheckIn.jsx so off-site sessions don't render 'Currently on campus Off-site · ...' (either drop the 'Currently on campus' prefix when out_of_geofence, or reword siteLine so the combined string is coherent).
Fix hydration warning in Layout.jsx (~line 376): an <option> element is being rendered inside a <span> in the sidebar Tasks badge/nav item.
critical_code_review_comments: tasks.py `_owner()` correctly rejects non-executive assignees with 400 — good.
Tasks router pack functions strip _id via projection — good.

Admin 'Viewing: Exec Test User' checklists view hides the add-form (correct per spec) but the Pause/Delete buttons remain enabled for admins on another user's checklist. Backend allows admin edits, so behavior is consistent; if the intent was strict read-only for admins viewing others, gate on `mine` only.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows working; 1 banner wording bug, 1 hydration warning)

test_credentials: Admin admin@attendance.app/Admin@12345; Exec exec.test@example.com/Exec@12345; Staff dar.test@example.com/Dar@12345 — login via 'Admin sign in with email' toggle on /login.
seed_data_creation: Created via UI as exec.test: TEST_daily_<ts>, TEST_dow_wednesday_<ts>, TEST_mo_lw_<ts> checklist items; TEST_todo_overdue_<ts> (deleted) and TEST_assigned_<ts> (assigned to ASIF AHMED) to-dos. Recommend cleanup via mongosh on db test_database (collections checklists, todos) filtering on titles starting with 'TEST_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully verified via /app/backend/tests/test_tasks_iter53.py. Frontend covered: sidebar Tasks link (exec=1, admin=1, staff=0), /tasks tabs render, checklist add for daily/dow/monthly-last_working, pause toggle, todo overdue label, assignment to another exec with disabled toggle for non-owner, own-todo done+delete, Today card pending count changes on tick, share-my-day button, admin scope 'Everyone' with enabled toggles on other users' todos, admin viewing another exec's checklist has no add form, staff /tasks returns 403 for group but page renders without crash, staff has no Tasks link. Exec check-out with DAR prefill (has ✅/⏳) succeeded and share-dar-btn appeared. Remaining bug is banner wording only.
rca of the issue: SelfCheckIn.jsx line ~332 unconditionally prefixes 'Currently on campus ' when status.checked_in is true, then concatenates siteLine which itself already prefixes 'Off-site · ' for out-of-geofence sessions. Fix: `${onTempOut ? 'Stepped out' : status?.checked_in ? (sess?.out_of_geofence ? siteLine : `Currently on campus ${siteLine}`) : 'Not on campus'}` or equivalent.
